name: @repo/vector-editor-toolbar
description: A Figma-style floating vector toolbar with tool selection, nested flyouts and a contextual properties bar.

useCases: Floating tool selector for a canvas or vector editor
Toolbar with nested tool variants revealed via long-press or caret
Contextual properties bar that expands per selected tool
compositionHints: Pass `properties` to reveal a contextual row for the active tool, omit it to collapse
Set `floating` to make the toolbar draggable within its parent container
Use `orientation` to switch between a horizontal and vertical layout
